player_intent: The stance control supports tap-to-crouch and hold-to-prone behavior while standing or crouched, and holding the stance button while prone returns directly to standing.
acceptance_rule: A quick stance release toggles standing and crouched; holding for 0.20 seconds enters prone, or starts the existing committed dive when the player is moving at the required speed; holding for 0.20 seconds while prone transitions directly to standing (or crouch under low ceilings); tapping while prone returns through crouch; CharacterBody3D remains the sole posture, collider, and clearance owner.

nodes.role: Consumes stance hold and release state and remains the sole posture, collider, committed-dive, and clearance owner.

must_not_change: CharacterBody3D movement speed, dive duration, displacement, collision, and clearance authority
delayed chest-supported dive weapon descent and both hand contacts
SOCOM camera, reticle, server shot, damage, reload, and multiplayer authority
directional locomotion and animation playback cadence
visual_check: In res://main.tscn, tap X/C to crouch, hold X/C to enter prone, tap twice through crouch to return to standing, and perform a running hold or dedicated dive. Confirm the old stance controls are restored and the rifle remains supported in both hands instead of striking the floor.

system_delta.reason: The requested double-tap and prone-hold gesture changed an already working stance convention. Restore the established hold recognizer while retaining the independently owned dive-rifle presentation fix.

current.system: Double-tap dive/prone plus prone-hold stand recognizer

candidate.system: Established tap crouch and hold prone/dive recognizer with the separate rifle-support presentation retained
